en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a modern-looking church surrounded by pine trees. The church has a tall, rectangular bell tower with a simple cross on top and a long, sloped roof on the nave. A pathway and some benches appear in the foreground, with a few small figures near the entrance. In the bottom left corner, printed text identifies the church, and a small publisher's logo with a number is in the bottom right.
